name: model-gateway
description: Your ChatGPT/Codex, Grok and OpenCode Go subscription models in Claude Code's /model picker. A local gateway routes claude-gpt-* models to OpenAI's Codex backend, claude-grok-* models to Grok, claude-opencodego-* models to OpenCode Go, and everything else to api.anthropic.com, so you switch between Claude, GPT-5.x, Grok, and OpenCode Go models mid-session like any other model.
